title: Paloma Business Ruling: Months Charged on an Early Downgrade
content:
For a downgrade of a Paloma Business account scheduled before the commitment end date, the months charged depend on the most recently collected subscription charge on the account's ledger, that is the subscription fee entry with the latest entry date, and on the billing period it was booked for. The periods still to run are counted as the whole months from the start of that period to the commitment end date, less one.

### Ruling

- When that charge was booked for the current billing period and its period starts 3 or more whole months after the committed plan took effect, the months charged are the periods still to run, but never more than the plan's early-termination months.
- When the period of that charge starts less than three whole months after the committed plan took effect, the months charged are all the periods still to run, with no limit.
- In every other case the months charged are the plan's early-termination months.

The date the committed plan took effect is the plan effective date shown on the account.

### Decision table

| Latest subscription fee entry booked for the current billing period | Its period starts 3 or more whole months after the committed plan took effect | Months charged |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The periods still to run, capped at the plan's early-termination months |
| Yes or no | No | All the periods still to run, uncapped |
| No | Yes | The plan's early-termination months |

### Dated cases (hypothetical; early-termination months of 3)

1. Plan took effect 10 January; commitment end date 10 January of the next year; current period starts 10 October. Latest subscription fee entry booked for the period starting 10 October: from 10 October to 10 January are 3 whole months, less one, so 2 periods still to run; that period starts 9 whole months after the plan took effect; months charged: 2 (below the cap of 3).
2. Same account, but the latest subscription fee entry is booked for the period starting 10 September: it is not the current period, and that period starts 8 whole months after the plan took effect; months charged: 3.
3. Plan took effect 25 February on an upgrade; commitment end date 25 February of the next year; latest subscription fee entry booked for the period starting 10 April: that period starts 1 whole month after the plan took effect, fewer than three; from 10 April to 25 February are 10 whole months, less one, so months charged: 9, with no cap.
